sentences.en: Stir the mixture until it foams, then set it aside.
sentences.zh: 搅拌混合物直到起泡沫，然后放一边。

sentences.en: I foam at the mouth whenever someone mentions his name.
sentences.zh: 只要提到他的名字，我就气得直咬牙。

sentences.en: The beer foamed over the top of the glass.
sentences.zh: 啤酒溢出了杯子的边缘。

senses.zh: 使起泡沫；使成泡沫状物
起泡沫；吐白沫；起着泡沫流动
